attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured a PAM limits drop-in (/etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf) capping its login sessions at 8,192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc), soft and hard. Verified enforcement via a real `su -` login session. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native systemd reboot, confirmed the connection dropped and the boot_id changed after recovery, and re-verified the account and its resource limits persisted post-restart.
